epic.intent:
## Outcome
Let app-hosted Skitarii (OMP) chats in the same tracked folder discover peers, send direct messages/replies and receive durable mail with visible and agent-aware notifications. Message delivery is separate from model processing: committed, notified, fetched and acknowledged are distinct.

## Scope and trust
Same canonical folder and machine; stable chat-level mailboxes across terminal restart/rename/vendor New session. Existing child workers share their parent chat mailbox and are not independently addressable. No remote/cross-folder messaging, broker, OS notification, broadcast or attachments. No dependency on the backlog hybrid-workspace epic; use the existing terminal/header/sidebar surfaces. Messages are local-only SQLite records, not portable Git records or history-search documents. An agent cannot choose its sender identity, bind a grant, read another mailbox or acknowledge someone else's message.

## Standards and delivery
Each ticket owns its named behavioral tests and runs targeted touched tests plus lint/typecheck for code changes. The acceptance node runs the complete current project Definition of Done once on combined work, including coverage. No extra tests-first or Fireguard grading requirement. Preserve Electron isolation and typed guarded IPC. No implementation or run is authorized by this planning request.

## Technical decisions
Use per-folder core SQLite and a desktop-provisioned grant-to-stable-endpoint binding; existing DM_SESSION_TOKEN authenticates native Skitarii CLI tools. Ordinary stdio MCP/unbound role sessions do not acquire mailbox ownership. Live notifications are recoverable hints over recipient-scoped polling, never the source of truth. Peer bodies are fetched only as tool-result data: OMP custom sendMessage content has developer priority and must never contain peer-authored content. Passive terminal/desktop alerts are default; immediate model wake requires an explicit human one-shot credit, consumed at most once and never automatically rearmed. No typing into PTYs, steering, or restarting a CLI for delivery.

## Verification boundary
Source vetting establishes feasibility, not shipped support. Execution must demonstrate the installed OMP extension API and real shell-free CLI child invocation, two real isolated Skitarii chats, persistence/replay, security denials and packaged resource loading. Missing live/platform evidence is unmet, not inferred from fakes. Local database recovery/backup guidance must acknowledge messages are not reconstructible from Git.

## Execution milestones
Sprint 1 ships durable authorized mailboxes, OMP-only chat binding and a shell-free native client seam; real bound CLI and installed OMP no-model adapter probes demonstrate it. Sprint 2 ships native messaging, guarded desktop monitor/UI and final documentation; real two-chat communication and packaged Windows/macOS proof complete it. Each sprint has its own human checkpoint and one acceptance node. No ticket requires the unimplemented hybrid-workspace epic.

successCriteria.text: In one folder, two app-hosted Skitarii chats discover stable peer IDs, exchange a direct message and correlated reply using native tools, including a stopped recipient that resumes later.

Messages and explicit agent acknowledgements survive app/terminal restart; duplicate sends are sender-scoped and do not duplicate mail within the documented retention window; human reading cannot consume the agent inbox.
Live terminal and desktop unread alerts recover after missed polls; peer text is inert tool-result data, and passive notifications never start or steer a model turn.

A person can authorize one immediate agent inbox wake; the credit is consumed once before a fixed trusted follow-up, cannot accumulate or rearm from peer traffic/restart, and does not falsely claim model processing.

Bound-grant ownership, folder/machine scope and current revocation are enforced in core services; spoofed senders, unbound/stdio callers and foreign read/ack requests are refused without private-body leakage.

The built and packaged app loads its bundled Skitarii messaging extension on supported Windows/macOS runtimes; targeted ticket tests, the combined project DoD and real isolated communication/restart journeys have recorded evidence.

epic.title: Skitarii communications: durable direct messages, replies and safe agent notifications

bundle.rationale:
## Evidence and decision record
Inspected current schema v14, shared workspace/grants/sessions, app-local ChatRecords, terminal lifecycle/env/files, CLI/MCP command boundaries, existing terminal/header/sidebar and bundled extension. Related history has no existing messaging epic; backlog hybrid workspace owns unrelated panes/activity/socket work, which is not a prerequisite. Existing four-role chat enum covers planner/orchestrator/worker/reviewer. Planning uses granted CLI orchestrator and args-file inputs; no runs/claims/code changes.

Independent read-only runtime/identity scouts and security/reliability reviews were completed. Accepted review fixes: independent body-free sender receipts with 8192-per-sender quota and seven-day acceptance expiry; pending quota 1024/retained quota 4096 per recipient, 16KiB UTF-8 bodies, 50-page/100-ack limits; monotonically nonreused message sequences and pinned page horizon; distinct human seen/agent ack (post-ack seven-day body retention can expire human-unseen messages); irreversible durable deletion tombstones vs reversible suspension; OMP-only binding from stored identity; existing repo.backup becomes desktop-only to close full-DB supported-API export; safe local rebuild/restore guidance; canonical-folder/logical-machine limits; restricted mailbox poll mode reusing bounded dedicated sessions and skipping unrelated reconciliation/flush/attachment pruning. These changes are required for correctness, not opportunistic scope.

OMP v18.18.0 release source matches installed updater metadata, but that is not live compatibility proof. Verified API: injected schema builders/registerTool, UI notify, ctx.agent.kind and lifecycle, before_agent_start fixed next-natural-turn reminder. Critical source finding: custom/hook messages convert to developer role, and triggerTurn:false is not universally passive while busy. Therefore peer text only enters explicit inbox tool results. Default terminal/UI alerts are passive; fixed reminder appears on an existing natural turn. Human-only one-shot wake may queue only constant text as followUp/triggerTurn:true; consumption returns positive once, not replayable idempotency. No input.source provenance assumption and no automatic rearming. API void return proves attempt only; crash can consume credit without wake.

Source references: https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/blob/v18.18.0/packages/coding-agent/src/extensibility/extensions/types.ts ; https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/blob/v18.18.0/packages/agent/src/compaction/messages.ts#L219-L238 ; https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/blob/v18.18.0/packages/coding-agent/src/session/agent-session.ts#L10501-L10618 .

Assumptions: local same-folder app-hosted OMP chats are intended peers. Native worker children share parent identity. No remote/cross-folder network, independent child credentials, OS notifications, broadcasts or sent-body history. Durable means local database retained, not recovery after deleting the database. Existing same-user filesystem access is not an OS sandbox. Source vetting does not certify new behavior: runtime/version, macOS executor and signed-in scratch provider are prerequisites for execution acceptance; missing evidence remains unmet. No unresolved architecture blocker; implementation compatibility remains deliberately gated by actual runtime smoke.

Graph: sprint1 store->API->lifecycle->transport; sprint2 extension and desktop bridge begin independently from accepted sprint1 contracts, UI requires bridge, docs joins UI+extension. Shared files isolated/worktrees or serialized by orchestrator. Max concurrency2; no extra integration/check tickets, full project DoD once per sprint acceptance. Human checkpoints remain mandatory. No tests-first/Fireguard added beyond current DoD.

## Responsibility
This is the sprint acceptance node, not an implementation placeholder. It implicitly waits for every required work ticket. Independently verify each covered item, run the entire current project Definition of Done once on combined work (npm run lint, npm run typecheck, npm test, npm run coverage, npm run deadcode, npm run build), fix failures and record actual evidence tied to the integrated revision. No added Fireguard grading or blanket tests-first. Integrate accepted work into the epic feature branch as required by orchestrator/acceptance workflow; report/checkpoint remains human-approved. Do not report passing criteria from mocks or source inspection alone.

## Verified source locations
package.json names the actual commands; src/core/db/migrations.test.ts and src/test/testContext.ts provide real SQLite fixtures; src/cli/main.test.ts covers command dispatch; src/main/terminals/__mocks__/terminalSessionsRig.ts is the native-lifecycle seam; src/main/terminals/skitariiExtension.test.ts is the extension harness (not real OMP proof); src/renderer/src/agents/TerminalPane.tsx is the actual surface. Existing package extraResources ships resources/skitarii outside app.asar.

## Evidence rules
Use isolated temporary userData/home/repos/grants and real encoded fixture content; do not use real user chats/tokens. Record OS, architecture, app/Node/Electron and installed OMP versions and source provenance. Use add_attachment for actual PNG/JPEG screenshots and attach IDs to evidence; never put credentials/private bodies in logs or general comments. Keep test execution targeted during tickets; this is the combined full gate. A missing platform/provider prerequisite is unmet evidence, not permission to shrink scope.

## Tests and smoke
Exercise actual built CLI with two desktop-provisioned scratch OMP chat endpoints and current bound grants: identity/discovery -> send -> retry same client ID -> different-payload conflict -> status/inbox paging -> reply -> owned ack. Close/reopen database/app; send to stopped peer and read after resume. Test zero/unbound/expired/revoked/foreign-folder/machine grants, mixed foreign ack rollback and unrelated reply with positive controls. Run >50 pending messages and concurrent arrival while paging, quota/prune/receipt-after-recipient-delete witness, monotonic seen, human ack separation and deleting-intent crash recovery. Confirm no bodies in tracked exports/events/history/logs.

Perform 1000 status opens/closes and two competing poll opens: one dedicated session per binding, bounded expired poll cleanup, no unrelated record reconcile/flush/staged-image prune; ordinary CLI session lifecycle remains unchanged. Attempt full backup with an unbound orchestrator (denied) and desktop (consistent VACUUM backup/reopen retains mail).

Run a no-model installed OMP scratch extension that imports the accepted dmClient and invokes literal fixture child stdin/JSON, including spaces and Unicode. Verify actual bundled Bun spawn/cancel, no PATH runtime lookup or secret descriptor, no remaining child. This is native adapter/API evidence, NOT proof of two-model communication, which belongs to Sprint 2. Record dependency prerequisites for real Windows/macOS + scratch provider before next checkpoint.

tickets.body:
## Outcome and contract
Add next core migration after the checked-out schema (currently v14); never hard-code an obsolete version if another epic lands first. New endpoint IDs are opaque and stable for (project database, machine ID, trusted chat ID); add unique keys/indexes for endpoint identity, grant binding, recipient sequence and sender-scoped clientMessageId. Store direct message/reply metadata, acknowledgement and a separate human-seen cursor. Endpoint names are trusted desktop metadata but still render inertly. Core repository functions perform no public caller-authority inference; the next ticket owns service authorization.

## Persistence semantics
Use core state.sqlite in both storage modes; no app.sqlite/message JSONL store, portable export, general event bodies, history-search or outbox messages. Ordinary reconciliation/branch changes must not erase mail. Acknowledged retention and dedup window are seven days; unacknowledged mail is never aged out. Enforce body <=16KiB UTF-8, pages <=50, ack batches <=100, recipient unacknowledged quota 1024 and retained message quota 4096; refuse mailbox_full rather than silently deleting pending mail. Store independent BODY-FREE sender/client-ID receipts (canonical payload hash, original acceptance result, acceptance timestamp, expiresAt). They survive recipient/message deletion and body cleanup for seven days from original acceptance; changed payload reuse conflicts. Authenticate the sender then consult its receipt BEFORE recipient availability/quota admission. Receipt quota is 8192 retained receipts per sender endpoint; receipt_quota_full refuses new sends, never drops an unexpired receipt. Message expiration is seven days after acknowledgement; unacknowledged rows never expire. Agent-acked but human-unseen bodies MAY expire after seven days; human counts include only retained rows and UI shows retention policy. Receipts have no body or FK cascade to message rows; reply FK must not cascade across recipients. Reply to an expired/purged parent returns reply_unavailable. Cleanup has bounded batches; no unbounded scan per send. Use a strictly increasing non-reused sequence (explicit AUTOINCREMENT or equivalent durable high-water), not recycled row IDs. Human seen advances only monotonically through the highest retained sequence actually displayed, never an arbitrary future head. Incoming history only is in scope: no sent-body history browser; send returns own acceptance receipt. Keep deletion/tombstone semantics explicit: delete recipient inbox; preserve delivered copies in other mailboxes with a deleted-sender tombstone.

A local SQLite database now contains non-reconstructible mail even in repo mode. Update project-mismatch advice immediately to require backing up/moving the directory before rebuild; do not leave a delete-the-only-copy instruction in an intermediate state. Existing backup_database is callable by unbound orchestrators and VACUUM INTO copies private mail: change full SQLite backup authorization to desktop-only, explicitly documenting the supported-API restriction. Do not silently offer agents an export-all-mail bypass. Move the existing repo.backup capability to HUMAN_ONLY_CAPABILITIES and remove agent-role access; preserve desktop consistent VACUUM INTO; no redacted/export fallback needed.

Persist durable deletion tombstones distinct from reversible suspension; provision/bind cannot reopen deleting/deleted endpoints. Store trusted canonical-folder namespace plus logical machine ID on bindings; project ID alone is insufficient for copied checkouts. Machine ID is a copied logical namespace, not physical-machine attestation.

Preserve existing SQLite transaction/lock behavior; provide atomic primitives needed by services.

## Source locations
- `src/core/db/migrations.ts`: schema and versioned migration
- `src/core/db/migrations.test.ts`: extend upgrade/rollback/inventory tests
- `src/core/db/database.ts`: reuse BEGIN IMMEDIATE and bounded lock handling
- `src/core/workspace.ts`: mismatchAdvice must protect local mail before rebuild
- `src/core/workspace.dbMode.test.ts`: storage mode preservation patterns
- `src/core/repo/backup.ts`: verify existing SQLite backup includes new local tables
- `src/core/repo/backup.test.ts`: extend real backup/reopen proof

### Intended new files (not existing paths)
- `src/core/services/agentMailStore.ts`: new local repository module; follow existing services/events.ts SQL/transaction style
- `src/core/services/agentMailStore.test.ts`: new real SQLite tests following services/grants.test.ts

## Tests
Extend migrations.test.ts, workspace.dbMode.test.ts and backup.test.ts. NEW src/core/services/agentMailStore.test.ts tests transactional persistence/reopen, same sender retry/changed payload, identical client IDs from different senders, reply relationships, quota boundaries in UTF-8, owned ack primitives, seven-day receipt/body pruning with clock control, deletion tombstones and bounded paging. Real backup reopen must retain endpoints/messages. Test upgrade rollback and both storage modes without writing message bodies to tracked files. No source-text/prose-pinning tests.

## Verification
Write and run the listed behavioral tests in this ticket. For changed code run touched test files plus npm run lint and npm run typecheck; full suite/coverage/deadcode/build run once at the sprint acceptance node. No blanket tests-first or Fireguard grading. Exercise the changed path with a targeted smoke; never infer installed OMP/Electron behavior from mocks. Preserve unrelated work. Do not self-accept.

acceptanceCriteria.text: All seven public commands have strict typed CLI discovery/aliases and enforce same-folder/machine bound-grant ownership even when services are called directly.
All four hosted roles can use their own mailbox; unbound/reader/stdio callers and agent management attempts fail, and spoof/foreign inbox/partial ack cannot disclose or mutate other mail.
Atomic sender-scoped retries, current revocation, correlated replies and cursor/status recovery pass real SQLite and competing-process tests without portable flush or body leakage.
Concurrent wake claims consume one desktop-granted credit at most once; restart/read/ack/peer activity cannot mint credit and lost dispatch is reported as attempted, not processed.
A thousand restricted status polls reuse a bounded dedicated session and skip unrelated reconcile/flush/pruning; ordinary command lifecycle and poll-mode whitelist remain enforced.

tickets.body:
## Outcome and public contract
Build on the mailbox store. Add typed get_agent_identity({}), list_agent_peers({afterId?,limit?}), send_agent_message({to,clientMessageId,body,inReplyTo?}), read_agent_inbox({afterSeq?,throughSeq?,limit?,unacknowledgedOnly?}), acknowledge_agent_messages({messageIds}), a lightweight get_agent_mail_status({afterSeq?,throughSeq?,limit?}) returning pending count and ascending unacknowledged metadata pages without bodies, with snapshotHighWater, nextCursor and hasMore, and take_agent_mail_wake({}) atomically consuming a desktop-granted nonaccumulating one-shot wake credit. Wake attempts have an opaque ID and are not delivery/read receipts; agent APIs can consume but never mint/rearm credit, including after restart. CamelCase aliases follow the registry. Identity is derived from the persisted sessions.grant_id resolved by ctx.session.id -> desktop-managed endpoint binding (SessionContext currently has no grantId property), never supplied from input; do not use ephemeral core/vendor session IDs, grant labels or PIDs as peers. Peer display shows title and stable ID; no transcript paths or credentials. Replies must refer to a message involving exactly the same two peers; reject unrelated existence probes.

## Authority and transactions
New mailbox discovery/send/receive capabilities apply to all four hosted roles planner/orchestrator/worker/reviewer, but every operation ALSO requires a current usable bound grant, same machine and open endpoint. Ungranted reader, role-only configured stdio and unbound grants are denied, not assigned an implicit mailbox. Revalidate grant usability and endpoint binding inside the same transaction as send/ack and private read snapshots (read the clock after acquiring the lock, including duplicate replay), closing the revoke-before-write race. Acknowledge validates all IDs/ownership before any mutation, is idempotent, and reading never acks. Do not reuse global withIdempotency, whose key lacks sender identity. No peer body/title in errors/logs/general events. Provide desktop-only endpoint provision/bind/update/close operations guarded by a dedicated capability in HUMAN_ONLY_CAPABILITIES and available only to desktop; separate human inbox/seen/wake methods also require that human-only authority; agents cannot self-register/rebind or close peers. Binding verifies grant and endpoint same project/machine. Services enforce authority even when called outside MCP discovery.

Expose strict schemas through CommandApi, registry, capabilities and CLI discovery. MCP lists role-appropriate APIs but direct role-only calls still reject without binding; document that native Skitarii tools use CLI. mutates:false for local mailbox writes to avoid portable flush/branch guards, with explicit service transactions; this flag is not an authorization shortcut. Do not regress existing role/grant rules. Inbox responses distinguish durable acceptance, explicit acknowledgement and cursor/high-water; human-seen state is separately desktop-owned.

## Source locations
- `src/shared/domain/api.ts`: typed command inputs/results
- `src/core/commandSchemas.ts`: strict bounded payloads
- `src/core/authz.ts`: separate mailbox and desktop-only management capabilities
- `src/core/commands/index.ts`: registry composition
- `src/core/commands/capabilities.ts`: exhaustive capability map
- `src/core/commands/types.ts`: local-write mutates semantics
- `src/core/services/grants.ts`: reuse usable-grant/machine checks
- `src/core/workspace.grants.test.ts`: real token/role/stdio provenance tests
- `src/core/commands/capabilities.test.ts`: extend exhaustive capability cases
- `src/cli/main.test.ts`: real CLI listing/aliases/stdin JSON
- `src/mcp/server.ts`: register mailbox tools
- `src/mcp/tools/define.ts`: existing MCP adapter convention
- `src/mcp/roles.test.ts`: role discovery/direct-call denials
- `src/mcp/validation.test.ts`: strict boundary tests

### Intended new files (not existing paths)
- `src/core/services/agentMail.ts`: new authorized service following services/grants.ts
- `src/core/commands/agentMail.ts`: new adapters following commands/comments.ts
- `src/mcp/tools/agentMail.ts`: new registration following tools/define.ts

## Tests
NEW src/core/services/agentMail.test.ts and src/core/commands/agentMail.test.ts exercise two endpoints plus foreign folder/machine, same client IDs from different senders, sender spoofing/unknown properties, unauthorized read and mixed owned/foreign ack rollback, missing/expired/revoked/unbound grants, desktop-only self-bind denial, unrelated replies, exact quota edges and concurrent send/ack/revoke with allowed positive controls. Extend workspace.grants, capabilities, CLI and MCP tests named above. Use real services/SQLite, not forwarding mocks. Add a two-process competing send test using existing testContext/workspaceHarness patterns. Run touched tests/lint/typecheck only.

## Verification
Write and run the listed behavioral tests in this ticket. For changed code run touched test files plus npm run lint and npm run typecheck; full suite/coverage/deadcode/build run once at the sprint acceptance node. No blanket tests-first or Fireguard grading. Exercise the changed path with a targeted smoke; never infer installed OMP/Electron behavior from mocks. Preserve unrelated work. Do not self-accept.

## Reviewed precision
Wake consumption is a conditional atomic transition requiring pending mail and a usable current binding. Only the winning invocation returns claimed:true; repeat/lost-response retry returns false and MUST NOT replay a positive authorization via generic idempotency. No auto refund. Closed bindings stay invalid forever even if a suspended endpoint later resumes; new trusted bind requires a fresh grant. Ordinary stdio callers cannot gain mailbox ownership from inherited DM_SESSION_TOKEN. Tool discovery/capabilities must make unbound state explicit, not falsely promise a usable mailbox.

For status paging capture a horizon before page read, never query a new head then advance over unseen concurrent arrivals. Ascending metadata pages carry nextCursor/hasMore and the same snapshot horizon; receive cursor continues across bounded ticks so first 50 older rows cannot starve later mail. Pending count reflects retained unacked state, not a stale notification flag.

Polling performance is part of this ticket: existing CLI creates a persisted session plus reconcile/flush on every command. Add an internal mailbox-poll opening mode selected only by CLI for status/wake commands and hard-enforced at execute; usable bound grant required. Reuse one dedicated polling session per (endpoint,grant), no activity references on that special session. Ordinary command sessions remain unchanged. Skip unrelated record reconcile/flush and staged-image pruning only in the restricted poll mode; preserve migration/current auth validation. A deterministic 1000-poll test must show constant session-row count per binding and zero unrelated filesystem/outbox maintenance. Parallel calls cannot allocate duplicate logical poll sessions; query/insert under transaction.

Tests additionally cover nonreplayed wake authorization after lost response, receipt survival through deleted recipient, advancing past >50 old unacked IDs, concurrent arrivals at page horizon, bound canonical-folder rejection and poll-only command whitelist denial with valid positive controls.

Poll-specific shared session lifecycle: do NOT call ordinary endSession on each poll close. Keep started_at stable; touch last_seen on successful polls and use the stale-session window. Atomically map/recheck endpoint+grant under lock. On expiry/revoke/delete, close/invalidate and prune only dedicated poll sessions with no activity references in bounded batches (limit 100), never arbitrary historical activity sessions. Enforce whitelist before dispatch; bypass both open-time and post-mutation flush. A take-wake positive result is never replayed. Test repeated opens/closes, two-process contention and ordinary CLI close unchanged.

tickets.body:
## Outcome
Integrate the authorized mailbox services into real chat lifecycle. Extend ChatRecord/ChatPatch with optional endpointId (legacy records open unchanged). The trusted tuple machine+canonical project+chat ID idempotently provisions the same endpoint even if a crash occurs between SQLite commit and JSONL patch. Provision existing OMP chat peers on trusted list/start so a stopped or never-started Skitarii chat can receive; never advertise unsupported CLI kinds. Titles are display metadata and rename does not change identity. Existing native subagents intentionally share their parent endpoint.

## Grant/lifecycle ordering
Pass trusted chat identity into issueChatCli; provision/bind each new usable grant before spawn and store the grant ID as existing code requires. A start cancelled after an await must revoke its binding/grant and may not recreate a closed endpoint or spawn a late CLI. Terminal stop/resume and vendor New session preserve mail; grant expiry/revocation is still enforced. Chat delete closes endpoint before transcript deletion, purges received mail, tombstones delivered outgoing sender metadata and cancels pending starts. Never reopen a closed/deleted endpoint based on stale asynchronous work. Untrack/removal/app quit stop polling/children consistently and retain mailbox data unless chat explicitly deleted; storage-inaccessible revoke is reported honestly. Use the originating workspace for cleanup, not a newly resolved folder. On next trusted startup reconcile managed endpoint ownership with existing ChatRecords so deletion/crash cannot leave discoverable zombie peers; no guessing across installations.

## Durable cross-store completion
Deleting is a durable irreversible state recorded before JSONL/file removal. On crash after marking deleting, startup FINISHES deletion instead of lazy-provisioning the still-present ChatRecord. Provision never reopens deleting/deleted tombstones. Suspension/untracked is distinct and may resume only via trusted main with a fresh grant; old bindings remain invalid permanently. If core storage cannot record closure, retain a visible retryable chat deletion failure instead of dropping the sole identity record and claiming success. Filter eligible OMP kind using stored chat+agent identity; generic grant issuance must not bind custom/other CLIs or external grants.

Untrack must explicitly notify/cancel mailbox/terminal owners before desktop handlers forget the folder/close its workspace; minute-based terminal detection is insufficient. Mailbox restoration requires both core backup and app-owned ChatRecord index; do not adopt restored old grants as a fresh live binding.

## Tests
Extend chatStore, chatRecords, chatGrants and terminal lifecycle/quit tests: restart/New session/rename preserve endpoint; stopped legacy OMP peer receives, unsupported kind stays unbound; same chat ID across folders isolated; crash-before-JSONL insert recovers same endpoint; crash after deleting intent completes deletion; suspended re-track binds fresh grant only. Race grant issue/deletion/untrack with real held workspace and prove no late resurrection/spawn. Storage failure retains retryable deletion UI state.

## Verification
Targeted touched tests plus lint/typecheck; smoke actual start/stop/delete ordering. Full DoD at sprint acceptance; no tests-first/Fireguard grading.

Create the runtime adapter and private descriptor consumed by the subsequent extension ticket. ## Outcome and verified API
Add a cohesive messaging module to resources/skitarii/extension loaded from existing index.ts beside the mascot. OMP release v18.18.0 source confirms injected pi.typebox, registerTool parameters/approval/loadMode, ctx.agent.kind, before_agent_start, ui.notify and lifecycle hooks. Current local OmpApi declares only mascot APIs: extend only the API actually verified; declarations alone are not compatibility proof. Use injected builders, no npm imports unavailable in unpacked resources. Native names: dm_agent_identity, dm_agent_peers, dm_message_send, dm_inbox_read, dm_inbox_ack. Expose strict literal arguments backed by core CLI, tool-result bodies inert task data, approval read for identity/peers/read and write for send/ack. Do not override native tool names. Agent can reply via send with inReplyTo; all four hosted roles work through their bound CLI grant. Feature-detect required APIs; unsupported OMP shows explicit messaging-unavailable reason without breaking mascot/chat, never a fake successful send.

## Accepted transport dependency
Use the accepted typed dmClient/descriptor adapter from the transport ticket. Do not reimplement spawning, environment pinning or descriptor lifecycle in this ticket. Native tools and all polling use the same adapter and bound grant.

## Notification semantics
Only main agent starts one metadata poll loop (2s, one child in flight, bounded pages, cancel+generation checks); children sharing token do not start competing consumers. Initial query catches up from zero through retained unacknowledged metadata, carrying cursor/horizon across bounded ticks rather than refetching first 50. Advance notification cursor only after UI notice succeeds; keep a bounded retry queue, no unbounded message-ID Set. A restart may replay notifications by design. Initial query recovers unread status, IDs/high-water; periodic status needs no bodies. Coalesce ui.notify and persistent unread indicator; ESC/OSC/control bytes from all peer metadata are inert. before_agent_start for main prompt returns only a CONSTANT extension-authored inbox reminder when cached pending>0; never peer bodies/titles/IDs and never modifies/replaces normal policy. It is pure/idempotent, does not start a turn or block on a CLI query, and may lag by one poll.

Immediate wake is explicitly one-shot: add take_agent_mail_wake({}) authorized own-bound-grant API in the API ticket, consuming a desktop-granted credit transactionally before any sendMessage. It returns a durable attempt ID/claimed flag, not delivery proof. No credit means no automatic call. A consumed credit may issue ONE constant hint via sendMessage({customType:dm-inbox-reminder,content:FIXED_TEXT,display:false}, {deliverAs:followUp,triggerTurn:true}); busy goes to follow-up, never steering. Do not interpolate peer data. API returns void: never ack mail, never refund/retry credit after throw/crash, show wake-attempted not processed. Credits do not rearm on polling, input.source, peer replies, reads/acks, agent end, session switch or restart. Human must explicitly grant another. This avoids unverifiable human-input provenance and unbounded ping-pong. Notification/injection does not acknowledge; explicit agent inbox ack owns that transition.
